mapper.select: SELECT aar.attr_id FROM pms_attr_attrgroup_relation aar INNER JOIN pms_attr_group ag ON aar.attr_group_id = ag.attr_group_id WHERE ag.catelog_id = #{categoryId}

SELECT aar.id, aar.attr_id, aar.attr_group_id, aar.attr_sort, pa.attr_name, pag.attr_group_name FROM pms_attr_attrgroup_relation aar LEFT JOIN pms_attr pa ON pa.attr_id = aar.attr_id LEFT JOIN pms_attr_group pag ON pag.attr_group_id = aar.attr_group_id WHERE aar.attr_group_id = #{attrGroupId} ORDER BY aar.attr_sort ASC

SELECT ag.attr_group_id, ag.attr_group_name, ag.sort, ag.descript, ag.icon AS group_icon, ag.catelog_id, a.attr_id, a.attr_name, a.search_type, a.value_type, a.icon AS attr_icon, a.value_select, a.attr_type, a.enable, a.catelog_id AS attr_catelog_id, a.show_desc, aar.attr_sort FROM pms_attr_group ag LEFT JOIN pms_attr_attrgroup_relation aar ON ag.attr_group_id = aar.attr_group_id LEFT JOIN pms_attr a ON aar.attr_id = a.attr_id AND a.catelog_id = #{catelogId} WHERE ag.catelog_id = #{catelogId} AND a.attr_type = 1 ORDER BY ag.attr_group_id, aar.attr_sort
